days.name: Day 1 — Build the Front Frame
days.focus: Chest, Front/Side Deltoids, Biceps, Brachialis, Abs

stretches.name: Chest Wall Stretch
stretches.description: Stand near a wall, place your forearm against it at 90 degrees, and gently rotate your body away.

stretches.name: Doorway Shoulder Stretch
stretches.description: Place both arms on the doorframe and take a step forward until you feel a stretch in your shoulders and chest.

stretches.name: Cross-Body Shoulder Stretch
stretches.description: Pull one arm straight across your chest using your opposite forearm, keeping your shoulder down.

stretches.name: Overhead Bicep/Tricep Stretch
stretches.description: Reach one hand down your spine, pulling the elbow back with the other hand, then interlace fingers and pull back to stretch biceps.

instructions.setup: Lie flat on the bench, feet flat on the floor. Grip the barbell slightly wider than shoulder-width.
instructions.movement: Unrack the barbell, lower it under control to your mid-chest, then press it back up forcefully to full extension.
instructions.breathing: Inhale on the way down, exhale as you push up.
instructions.commonMistakes: Bouncing the bar off the chest, flaring elbows out to 90 degrees, lifting hips off the bench.
instructions.safety: Ensure a secure grip and use a spotter or safety pins for heavy sets.
instructions.cues: Squeeze shoulder blades together, keep feet planted, drive through the floor.

instructions.setup: Adjust the seat height so the handles align with your shoulders. Sit back with a neutral spine.
instructions.movement: Grip handles tightly and press upwards until arms are nearly fully locked, then lower slowly back to start position.
instructions.breathing: Exhale as you press, inhale as you lower.
instructions.commonMistakes: Arching your lower back excessively, not utilizing the full range of motion.
instructions.safety: Select a weight that allows you to control the eccentric phase.
instructions.cues: Keep core tight, push the handles straight up, don't bang the weights.

instructions.setup: Adjust the seat so pads rest on your outer arms. Place chest against chest-pad if applicable.
instructions.movement: Raise elbows outwards in an arc until they reach shoulder height, pause briefly, then lower slowly.
instructions.breathing: Exhale on the raise, inhale on the descent.
instructions.commonMistakes: Shrugging the shoulders up, using momentum or swinging, raising wrists higher than elbows.
instructions.safety: Perform with high control; avoid jerky movements to protect the shoulder joint.
instructions.cues: Lead with the elbows, push outwards, keep shoulders depressed.

instructions.setup: Set cable pulleys to chest height. Grab handles and step forward into a staggered stance, keeping a slight bend in your elbows.
instructions.movement: Bring handles together in a wide arc in front of your chest. Squeeze chest muscles at completion, then slowly return.
instructions.breathing: Exhale as you close, inhale as you open.
instructions.commonMistakes: Bending elbows too much (turning it into a press), leaning forward too much, using shoulders to pull.
instructions.safety: Ensure cables don't pull shoulders past a comfortable range of motion.
instructions.cues: Hug a big tree, squeeze your inner chest, keep elbows fixed.

instructions.setup: Sit on the preacher bench, armpits resting snuggly against the top of the pad. Hold the EZ-bar on the inner grips.
instructions.movement: Lower the bar slowly until arms are fully extended. Curl the bar up towards face, squeezing biceps at the top.
instructions.commonMistakes: Lifting elbows off the pad, not extending fully at the bottom, swinging the body.
instructions.safety: Do not hyperextend elbows at the bottom of the movement.
instructions.cues: Keep armpits glued to the pad, squeeze biceps at the top, control the stretch.

instructions.setup: Stand tall with dumbbells at your sides, neutral grip (palms facing in).
instructions.movement: Without rotating the wrist, curl the dumbbell of one arm across your chest toward the opposite shoulder. Lower and alternate.
instructions.breathing: Exhale as you curl up, inhale as you lower.
instructions.commonMistakes: Swinging hips, moving elbows forward, using momentum.
instructions.safety: Keep torso braced to avoid lumbar extension.
instructions.cues: Curl towards opposite shoulder, keep thumb pointing up, control the down phase.

instructions.setup: Hang from a pull-up bar with an overhand grip, shoulders active (pull down away from ears).
instructions.movement: Keep legs straight or slightly bent, and raise them up until they are parallel to the floor (or higher). Lower slowly.
instructions.breathing: Exhale as you raise, inhale as you lower.
instructions.commonMistakes: Swinging your legs, using momentum, shrugging shoulders up.
instructions.safety: Do not swing or bounce at the bottom. Keep control.
instructions.cues: Initiate with abs, roll your pelvis up, control the descent.

instructions.setup: Get into a forearm plank position, with a partner safely placing a plate on your upper/mid back.
instructions.movement: Hold a rigid body line, squeeze glutes, abs, and thighs. Do not let lower back sag.
instructions.breathing: Take shallow, controlled breaths while maintaining core tension.
instructions.commonMistakes: Letting lower back arch/sag, raising hips too high, looking up (neck extension).
instructions.safety: If lower back hurts, immediately have your partner remove the weight or drop to knees.
instructions.cues: Push the elbows into the floor, squeeze glutes, keep neck long.

days.name: Day 2 — Build the Monster Back
days.focus: Lats, Back Thickness, Traps, Rear Delts, Triceps, Forearms, Abs

stretches.name: Child's Pose
stretches.description: Kneel on the floor, sit back on your heels, and reach your arms far forward on the floor, lowering your chest.

stretches.name: Lat Stretch on Wall
stretches.description: Place one hand on a wall or pole at shoulder height, push your hips back, and lower your torso until you feel the lat stretch.

stretches.name: Cat-Cow Stretch
stretches.description: On hands and knees, alternate between arching your back upward (cat) and dipping it down while looking up (cow).

stretches.name: Cobra Stretch
stretches.description: Lie face down, place hands under shoulders, and press up to lift your chest while keeping hips on the floor.

instructions.setup: Adjust the seat and chest pad so you can stretch fully to reach the handles. Secure thighs under the rollers.
instructions.movement: Pull the handles down and back, driving elbows towards your ribs. Squeeze lats at the bottom, then extend slowly.
instructions.breathing: Exhale as you pull, inhale as you stretch.
instructions.commonMistakes: Using biceps too much, shrugging shoulders up, cutting range of motion.
instructions.safety: Ensure chest stays firmly against the pad throughout to protect the spine.
instructions.cues: Pull through your elbows, squeeze shoulder blades down, feel the stretch at the top.

instructions.setup: Attach neutral grip bar. Sit down, locking thighs under pads. Reach up to grip the handles.
instructions.movement: Pull the bar down to upper chest, keeping elbows tucked close to body. Return slowly under control.
instructions.breathing: Exhale as you pull down, inhale on return.
instructions.commonMistakes: Leaning back too far, pulling bar behind neck, bouncing.
instructions.safety: Avoid jerky motion; load must be controlled on eccentric return.
instructions.cues: Elbows in back pockets, chest high, squeeze the lats.

instructions.setup: Attach rope or straight bar to high pulley. Stand back slightly, feet shoulder-width, soft knees, torso hinged forward.
instructions.movement: Keep arms nearly straight. Pull the bar down to your thighs, squeezing lats. Raise back up to start with control.
instructions.commonMistakes: Bending elbows too much, arching/swinging lower back, shrugging shoulders.
instructions.safety: Do not let the stack slam; control the deceleration at the top.
instructions.cues: Keep arms locked, sweep the bar in an arc, press shoulders down.

instructions.setup: Set dual cables at head height without handles (grab bare cable ends). Stand centered, arms crossed in front.
instructions.movement: Pull arms back and outwards horizontally in a wide arc until arms are in line with shoulders. Return slowly.
instructions.breathing: Exhale on opening, inhale on closing.
instructions.commonMistakes: Using triceps (bending elbows), shrugging, squeezing shoulder blades too early (using traps).
instructions.safety: Do not over-extend wrists; maintain neutral hand position.
instructions.cues: Fly outwards, lead with knuckles, isolate the back of the shoulder.

instructions.setup: Mount parallel bars. If weighted, attach dip belt or hold dumbbell between feet. Keep arms straight but not hyperlocked.
instructions.movement: Lower your body by bending elbows until upper arms are parallel to the floor, leaning slightly forward. Press back up.
instructions.breathing: Inhale on descent, exhale on press.
instructions.commonMistakes: Going too deep (shoulder strain), flaring elbows, bouncing at the bottom.
instructions.safety: Stop if shoulder joint feels sharp pain. Start bodyweight only to verify depth.
instructions.cues: Lean slightly forward, control the descent, press up tall.

instructions.setup: Set pulley to mid-height, attach rope. Face away from stack in a split stance. Lean forward, hands behind head.
instructions.movement: Keeping elbows fixed close to ears, press hands forward and extend elbows fully. Squeeze and split the rope. Return slowly.
instructions.breathing: Exhale on extension, inhale on return.
instructions.commonMistakes: Moving elbows, flaring elbows out, arching lower back.
instructions.safety: Ensure firm footing to prevent being pulled back by the stack.
instructions.cues: Keep elbows pointed forward, lock elbows out, stretch behind head.

instructions.setup: Deadlift two heavy dumbbells or handles to standing. Stand tall, shoulders packed down and back.
instructions.movement: Take quick, small, controlled steps forward for the designated duration. Maintain a rigid torso.
instructions.commonMistakes: Slouching forward, looking down, letting weights swing.
instructions.safety: Lower weights safely via a squat/deadlift format if grip fails.
instructions.cues: Chest high, shoulders packed, tight core, active steps.

instructions.setup: Kneel on a soft pad. Place ab wheel on floor in front of you, arms extended under shoulders.
instructions.movement: Roll the wheel forward, extending your hips and torso toward the floor. Keep core hollowed. Pull back using abs.
instructions.breathing: Inhale as you roll out, exhale as you pull back.
instructions.commonMistakes: Arching lower back, pulling back with arms instead of abs, sagging hips.
instructions.safety: Only roll out as far as you can control without lower back pain or sagging.
instructions.cues: Keep lower back rounded (hollow body), squeeze glutes, pull with stomach.

instructions.setup: Set pulley at chest height. Stand sideways to cable. Grasp handle with both hands, pull it to center of chest.
instructions.movement: Press handle straight out in front of chest. Hold for a 2-second count, resisting side pull. Return to chest.
instructions.breathing: Exhale as you press, inhale as you return.
instructions.commonMistakes: Letting torso twist towards stack, shifting weight, rushing reps.
instructions.safety: Ensure stance is wide enough to stay firmly anchored.
instructions.cues: Do not let the cable twist your torso, press straight, hold the lock.

days.name: Day 3 — Fix the Foundation
days.focus: Quadriceps, Hamstrings, Glutes, Calves, Tibialis, Ankles

stretches.name: Standing Quad Stretch
stretches.description: Stand on one leg, grab the ankle of the other behind you, and pull it close to your glute while keeping knees aligned.

stretches.name: Lying Hamstring Stretch
stretches.description: Lie on your back, lift one leg straight up, and pull it gently toward your head using hands or a strap.

stretches.name: Deep Glute Stretch
stretches.description: Cross one ankle over the opposite knee in a figure-4 position, either sitting or lying down, and pull the thigh closer.

stretches.name: Calf Stretch against Wall
stretches.description: Place toes of one foot high against a wall, keep the heel on the floor, and lean your hips forward.

instructions.setup: Position back firmly against the carriage pad. Place feet shoulder-width apart on plate. Disengage safety handles.
instructions.movement: Lower carriage slowly by bending knees until thighs are parallel to plate (or lower). Press back up to starting position.
instructions.breathing: Inhale on descent, exhale on press up.
instructions.commonMistakes: Knees caving inwards, lower back or hips lifting off pad, locking knees forcefully at top.
instructions.safety: Always ensure safety stops are set at a safe height. Never lock knees.
instructions.cues: Press lower back into pad, push through heels, spread knees apart.

instructions.setup: Stand with feet hip-width apart. Hold barbell or dumbbells in front of thighs with an overhand grip. Core tight.
instructions.movement: Hinge at hips, pushing them back. Lower the weights down front of legs, keeping back flat. Squeeze glutes to return.
instructions.breathing: Inhale hinge down, exhale stand up.
instructions.commonMistakes: Rounding the lower back, letting weights drift forward, bending knees too much.
instructions.safety: Keep bar close to legs. Do not overload; focus on hamstrings stretch.
instructions.cues: Push wall away with hips, shave your legs with the bar, hinge don't squat.

instructions.setup: Stand about two feet in front of a bench. Place top of one foot flat on the bench behind you. Hold dumbbells in hands.
instructions.movement: Lower front hip until back knee is just above floor, front thigh parallel. Push back up using front leg.
instructions.commonMistakes: Front knee traveling too far forward, losing balance, torso collapsing.
instructions.safety: Ensure knee does not track too far sideways. Go bodyweight first if balance is tricky.
instructions.cues: Drop your hips straight down, drive through front heel, stay tall.

instructions.setup: Lie face down or sit on machine. Align knees with pivot joint. Secure pad against back of calves.
instructions.movement: Curl legs fully towards glutes, squeezing hamstrings at maximum contraction. Return slowly under control.
instructions.breathing: Exhale on curl, inhale on return.
instructions.commonMistakes: Hips lifting off pad (lying), slamming weights, rushing return.
instructions.safety: Perform with absolute control to prevent knee strain.
instructions.cues: Pull heels to glutes, squeeze at bottom, resist the return.

instructions.setup: Position shoulders under pads on calf block. Step balls of feet onto block, heels hanging off.
instructions.movement: Lower heels to maximum stretch, hold 1s. Press up as high as possible on toes, hold 1s.
instructions.breathing: Inhale on stretch down, exhale on press up.
instructions.commonMistakes: Bouncing, locking knees fully, not pausing at the bottom or top.
instructions.safety: Perform slowly to protect Achilles tendon.
instructions.cues: Get deep stretch, pause, push up tall on big toes, pause.

instructions.setup: Stand with upper back against wall, heels about 1-2 feet away. Arms at sides.
instructions.movement: Keeping legs straight, pull toes up towards knees as high as possible. Pause, then lower slow.
instructions.commonMistakes: Bending knees, peeling hips off wall, using momentum.
instructions.safety: Ensure knees remain locked but not hyperextended.
instructions.cues: Toes to shins, squeeze the front of the shin, slow on descent.

stretches.name: Hip-Flexor Stretch
stretches.description: Kneel on one knee, hinge forward slightly, squeezing the glute of the trailing leg.

stretches.name: Standing Quadriceps Stretch
stretches.description: Stand on one leg, hold the opposite ankle, and pull it gently toward your glutes.

stretches.name: Figure-Four Glute Stretch
stretches.description: Cross one ankle over the opposite knee, hinge at the hips, and sit back to stretch.

stretches.name: Hamstring Stretch
stretches.description: Extend one leg forward, hinge at the hips with a flat back, and lean in.

stretches.name: Calf Stretch
stretches.description: Step one leg back, keeping the heel on the floor and leaning forward.

instructions.setup: Sit on the floor with your upper back against a bench. Roll a barbell over your hips.
instructions.movement: Drive through your heels to raise your hips until parallel to the floor. Pause at the top.
instructions.breathing: Inhale down, exhale as you drive up.
instructions.commonMistakes: Extending the lower back excessively, not reaching full extension.
instructions.safety: Use a hip pad to cushion the bar. Keep your neck neutral.
instructions.cues: Drive through heels, squeeze glutes at top, tuck chin.

instructions.setup: Position your back flat against the pad and shoulders under the pads. Place feet shoulder-width apart.
instructions.movement: Release the safety bars, lower down under control until thighs are parallel, then press back up.
instructions.commonMistakes: Bouncing at the bottom, letting knees cave in.
instructions.safety: Do not lock knees out fully at the top.
instructions.cues: Keep heels flat, push knees out, control descent.

instructions.setup: Stand facing away from a bench. Place the top of one foot flat on the bench behind you.
instructions.movement: Lower your body until your rear knee is close to the floor, then press back up with your front leg.
instructions.commonMistakes: Leaning too far forward, letting front knee cave inward.
instructions.safety: Ensure balance before adding dumbbell weight.
instructions.cues: Drive through front heel, chest up, control descent.

instructions.setup: Stand tall with feet together, holding dumbbells or using bodyweight.
instructions.movement: Take a step forward and lower your hips until your back knee is just above the floor, then drive up.
instructions.breathing: Inhale down, exhale as you step up.
instructions.commonMistakes: Step is too short, front knee arches past toes.
instructions.safety: Keep torso upright to protect lower back.
instructions.cues: Step out wide, keep chest high, control balance.

instructions.setup: Sit in the extension machine, adjusting the back pad so your knees align with the pivot point.
instructions.movement: Grip handles, extend legs fully, pause briefly, then lower under control.
instructions.commonMistakes: Swinging the weight, lifting hips off the seat.
instructions.safety: Do not hyperextend knees at top.
instructions.cues: Squeeze quads at top, slow on descent.

instructions.setup: Sit in leg curl machine, place back of ankles against lower roll pad and secure thighs.
instructions.movement: Pull heels back towards glutes, squeeze, then return slow to starting position.
instructions.commonMistakes: Jerking the load, incomplete range of motion.
instructions.safety: Make sure thigh pad is snug to prevent sliding.
instructions.cues: Pull heels back, squeeze hamstrings, resist up.

instructions.setup: Attach ankle strap to low cable pulley. Stand facing the machine, holding handles for stability.
instructions.movement: Kick your leg back and slightly up, squeezing the glute at peak. Return under control.
instructions.commonMistakes: Arching lower back, using torso swing.
instructions.safety: Hold support handles firmly to maintain spinal alignment.
instructions.cues: Squeeze glute, kick backward, don't arch lower back.

instructions.setup: Stand on the edge of a step, heels hanging off, holding a support.
instructions.movement: Press up onto your toes, squeeze calves, then lower heels down below the step.
instructions.commonMistakes: Bouncing at bottom, fast reps without pause.
instructions.safety: Hold a wall or bar for balance.
instructions.cues: Hold stretch at bottom, squeeze hard at top.

instructions.setup: Lie on your back, arms extended to ceiling, knees bent at 90 degrees.
instructions.movement: Slowly lower opposite arm and leg toward floor, keeping lower back pressed into ground. Return and alternate.
instructions.commonMistakes: Lifting lower back off the floor, rushing movement.
instructions.safety: Stop if you feel lower back strain.
instructions.cues: Ribs down, press lower back into floor, extend long.

instructions.setup: Rest on forearms and toes. Keep your body in a straight line.
instructions.movement: Squeeze glutes, legs, and abs, holding the static position.
instructions.commonMistakes: Sagging hips, raising head, holding breath.
instructions.safety: Stop if you feel pinching in the lower back.
instructions.cues: Tuck pelvis, push elbow into floor, squeeze glutes.

days.name: Day 2 — Back, Shoulders, and Arms
days.focus: Lats, Upper Back, Rear Delts, Side Delts, Biceps, Triceps

stretches.name: Lat Stretch on Wall
stretches.description: Stand near a wall, place one hand on the wall at shoulder height, hinge hips and sink back.

stretches.name: Chest & Shoulder Stretch
stretches.description: Interlace fingers behind your back, roll shoulders back, and lift chest up.

stretches.name: Cross-Body Rear-Shoulder Stretch
stretches.description: Pull one arm across chest using opposite hand, stretching back of shoulder.

stretches.name: Triceps Stretch
stretches.description: Reach one hand behind neck, pulling the elbow back with the other hand.

stretches.name: Forearm Stretch
stretches.description: Extend one arm, fingers pointing down, pull back gently on fingers.

instructions.setup: Sit under the pulley, secure thighs under pads, grip neutral handles.
instructions.movement: Pull the handles down to upper chest, leading with elbows. Return slow.
instructions.commonMistakes: Using body swing, leaning back excessively.
instructions.safety: Release slowly at the top.
instructions.cues: Elbows to pockets, squeeze lats, control negative.

instructions.setup: Sit facing row machine pad, rest chest flat against pad, hold handles.
instructions.movement: Pull handles back, squeezing shoulder blades together. Return under control.
instructions.commonMistakes: Lifting chest off pad, shrugging shoulders up.
instructions.safety: Do not overextend spine at top.
instructions.cues: Squeeze shoulder blades, drive elbows back.

instructions.setup: Adjust seat so handles are at shoulder height. Sit tall.
instructions.movement: Press handles straight overhead, pausing briefly before lowering.
instructions.commonMistakes: Arching lower back, lifting hips.
instructions.safety: Keep wrists aligned above elbows.
instructions.cues: Core tight, press overhead, slow down.

instructions.setup: Sit tall, place forearms against pad, elbows bent.
instructions.movement: Raise elbows out to the side until level with shoulders. Lower slowly.
instructions.commonMistakes: Shrugging shoulders, fast swinging.
instructions.safety: Stop if you feel shoulder impingement.
instructions.cues: Lead with elbows, keep neck relaxed.

instructions.setup: Set cables at chest height. Hold opposite cables (left to right, right to left) without handles.
instructions.movement: Pull arms out and back in a wide arc, squeezing back of shoulder. Return slowly.
instructions.commonMistakes: Bending elbows too much, shrugging.
instructions.safety: Control the eccentric phase.
instructions.cues: Squeeze rear delts, keep arms nearly straight.

instructions.setup: Set cable high with rope attachment. Stand back, hold rope ends.
instructions.movement: Pull rope towards forehead, parting rope ends and squeezing rear shoulders.
instructions.commonMistakes: Pulling too low, using upper trap shrugging.
instructions.safety: Maintain a stable standing stance.
instructions.cues: Pull rope to nose, squeeze back of shoulders.

instructions.setup: Stand facing low cable pulley with straight bar attachment. Grip underhand.
instructions.movement: Curl bar upwards, keeping elbows locked at sides. Lower under control.
instructions.commonMistakes: Elbows moving forward, swinging upper body.
instructions.safety: Do not lock out elbows aggressively at bottom.
instructions.cues: Elbows glued to ribs, squeeze biceps at top.

instructions.setup: Stand facing high cable pulley with rope. Grip ends, tuck elbows at 90 degrees.
instructions.movement: Press rope downwards, separating rope ends at bottom. Return slow.
instructions.commonMistakes: Elbows flaring, shoulders rolling forward.
instructions.safety: Control the weight on the way up.
instructions.cues: Lock elbows at sides, pull rope apart at bottom.

instructions.setup: Pick up two heavy dumbbells with neutral grip. Stand tall.
instructions.movement: Walk in a straight line with slow, deliberate steps, maintaining a tight trunk.
instructions.commonMistakes: Rolling shoulders forward, looking down, rushing.
instructions.safety: Pick up and put down dumbbells with correct leg-bending form.
instructions.cues: Shoulders back and down, tight core, steady pace.

days.name: Day 3 — Glutes, Hamstrings, and Chest
days.focus: Glutes, Hamstrings, Chest, Core, Hip Stability

stretches.name: Hamstring Stretch
stretches.description: Place foot forward, flat back, hinge at hips and lean down.

stretches.name: Glute Stretch
stretches.description: Cross one ankle over opposite thigh, sink back to stretch glutes.

stretches.name: Hip-Flexor Stretch
stretches.description: Kneel on one knee, lean forward, stretch trailing hip.

stretches.name: Chest Stretch
stretches.description: Place forearms against wall or doorway and lean forward.

stretches.name: Adductor Butterfly Stretch
stretches.description: Sit with soles of feet together, pull heels in, gently press knees down.

stretches.name: Child’s Pose
stretches.description: Kneel, sit back on heels, reach arms forward onto floor.

instructions.setup: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding barbell or dumbbells. Keep shoulders back.
instructions.movement: Hinge at the hips, pushing them backward. Lower weight along shins until hamstring limit. Drive up.
instructions.commonMistakes: Rounding the back, bending knees too much.
instructions.safety: Keep bar close to body. Keep back neutral.
instructions.cues: Push hips back, shave your shins, squeeze glutes.

instructions.setup: Lie on your back, knees bent, feet flat on the floor close to your hips.
instructions.movement: Squeeze glutes and press through heels to lift hips to ceiling. Pause, lower under control.
instructions.commonMistakes: Lifting heels off the ground, hyperextending back.
instructions.safety: Add weight to hips only once bodyweight form is stable.
instructions.cues: Press heels, tuck hips, squeeze glutes.

instructions.setup: Sit in chest press machine. Adjust handles to chest height. Feet flat.
instructions.movement: Press handles forward to full extension under control. Return slowly.
instructions.commonMistakes: Bouncing weights, shoulder rolling forward.
instructions.safety: Select a range of motion comfortable for your shoulders.
instructions.cues: Push away, squeeze chest, slow on return.

instructions.setup: Set pulleys to chest height. Hold handles, stand in middle with split stance.
instructions.movement: Bring hands together in wide arc in front of chest, squeeze, return slow.
instructions.commonMistakes: Clapping handles, bending elbows excessively.
instructions.safety: Control the stretch position.
instructions.cues: Hug a tree, squeeze chest, slow on return.

instructions.setup: Sit in leg curl machine, place back of ankles against lower roll pad and secure thighs.
instructions.movement: Pull heels back towards glutes, squeeze, then return slow to starting position.
instructions.commonMistakes: Jerking the load, incomplete range of motion.
instructions.safety: Make sure thigh pad is snug to prevent sliding.
instructions.cues: Pull heels back, squeeze hamstrings, resist up.

instructions.setup: Stand facing away from low cable pulley with rope attachment. Grip rope between legs.
instructions.movement: Hinge at the hips. Drive hips forward to stand upright, squeezing glutes.
instructions.breathing: Inhale hinge back, exhale stand up.
instructions.commonMistakes: Pulling with arms, arching lower back.
instructions.safety: Maintain a flat back throughout.
instructions.cues: Push hips back, squeeze glutes to stand, arm straight.

instructions.setup: Sit in abduction machine, place outer knees against pad, select weight.
instructions.movement: Push knees out wide against the pads. Squeeze glutes. Return slowly.
instructions.commonMistakes: Using momentum, fast return.
instructions.safety: Sit back completely in the seat.
instructions.cues: Push knees wide, squeeze glutes, control return.

instructions.setup: Stand in front of a flat box or bench. Place front foot entirely on the step.
instructions.movement: Drive through front foot to step up onto the bench, keeping back foot light. Return under control.
instructions.commonMistakes: Pushing off back foot, stepping too high.
instructions.safety: Ensure step is secure and stable.
instructions.cues: Drive through front heel, control descent, stand tall.

instructions.setup: Set cable to chest height. Hold handle in both hands, stand sideways to pulley. Pull to chest.
instructions.movement: Press handle straight out in front of chest. Hold, resist lateral pull. Return to chest.
instructions.commonMistakes: Leaning, letting cable pull torso.
instructions.safety: Maintain a solid stance.
instructions.cues: Brace abs, press straight, resist rotation.

instructions.setup: Lie on your side. Lift hips, resting on forearm and side of foot.
instructions.movement: Hold body straight, hips elevated, core braced.
instructions.commonMistakes: Dropping hips, rolling chest down.
instructions.safety: Keep elbow directly under shoulder.
instructions.cues: Elevate hips, brace abs, side straight.
